sources.note: Silent: the words 'stress'/'accent'/'prominence' do not occur in the body. Contains first-hand General Wordlist and Tone Wordlist data recorded in Yucunicoco (YUC) plus six vmc towns, isogloss and tone-pattern analyses (ch. 3), a pitch note distinguishing L from M tone (PDF p.41), and an appendix note (PDF p.115) that underlying CV words lengthen to CVV/CVʔV to satisfy a two-mora minimal word (citing McKendry 2013). Recommends YUC stay under INALI 'mixteco del oeste alto', separate from the other six varieties.
